selection.method: Source-only selection from public Microsoft and independent repositories after Microsoft P0/P1 implementation. No HorusTrace output from this cohort was used to select cases. Cases are scanned at application_path rather than at whole-repository scope so multiple independent sample applications in a monorepo remain distinct.
selection.interpretation: Expansion validation holdout, not a claim that every source pattern was unseen during implementation. The core MAF case is a regression sentinel; newer Agent 365, M365 Agents SDK, GitHub Copilot SDK and hybrid cases test real-source generalization.

cases.source_signal: Sequential .NET MAF workflow composed from multiple agents; validates that workflow-as-agent/delegated participant authority remains intact after later Microsoft adapters.
Python Agent Framework application dynamically attaches Agent 365 MCP tooling through McpToolRegistrationService with agentic/OBO authentication context.
AgentApplication ingress combines agentic and OBO auto-sign-in handlers with Agent 365 tooling; ToolingManifest declares authenticated Mail MCP authority.
Windows 365 computer-use agent combines AgentApplication routes, multiple authenticated MCP destinations, conditional W365 tooling, screen-share identity and computer-control orchestration.
Standalone Windows 365 Agent 365 application registers ToolingManifest-backed MCP tooling plus channel authentication, computer-use orchestration and screen-share support.
Independent Agent 365 teammate demo reads ToolingManifest URL/audience/scope and directly connects Work IQ MCP servers, exercising manifest-to-runtime binding outside Microsoft sample code.
M365 Agents SDK sample wires ASP.NET authentication and OBO user authorization, exercising delegated identity and downstream Microsoft Graph access.
AgentApplication uses per-route auto-sign-in handlers, turn tokens and Microsoft Graph calls, testing route-scoped delegated-user authority.
Hosted M365 Agents SDK application registers multiple AgentApplication implementations behind the authenticated runtime, testing multi-agent inventory and route isolation.
M365 AgentApplication obtains a delegated GitHub OAuth token then creates a Copilot SDK session with approve-all and custom tools, joining ingress identity to Copilot effective authority.
GitHubCopilotAgent MAF integration includes approve-all, function tools and local/remote MCP configuration; validates that the wrapper preserves underlying Copilot CLI authority.
Independent production backend integrates CopilotClient/Tool into a multi-agent system with configurable execution, native hooks and SDK-owned sessions.
Independent Python application builds a session configuration dictionary and injects custom SDK tools before calling create_session, testing indirection rather than keyword-only construction.

Media conversion application creates streaming Copilot sessions with approve-all; the surrounding application turns model output into local media commands, testing whether built-in authority is reconstructed conservatively.
Agent workbench composes Copilot session manifests, available-tool modes, custom agent profiles and define_tool wrappers across modules, stressing repository-local indirection.
Real .NET tooling wraps CopilotClient behind an interface and passes SessionConfig through helper layers, testing C# alias/wrapper indirection rather than direct top-level construction.
